name: PPT 演示稿
description: 从一个主题做出一份演示稿：先定一句话的核心结论和 SCQA 开场（金字塔原理），再让每页标题都是一句结论、正文是证据（assertion-evidence），排成网页幻灯片，最后检查。 / Make a slide deck from a topic: settle the one-sentence governing thought and an SCQA opening (Pyramid Principle), make every slide title a claim backed by evidence (assertion-evidence), lay it out as an HTML deck, then check it.

topic.description: 演示主题，例如：我们团队为什么要用流程化工作 / What the talk is about

slides.description: 大约几页（含封面）/ About how many slides, cover included

theme.description: 配色：light 浅色，dark 深色 / Colors: light or dark

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 大纲
stages.description: 一句话核心结论、SCQA 开场，再按金字塔结构排出每页：页标题就是这页的结论。 / The governing thought, an SCQA opening, then every slide in pyramid order, each titled with its claim.

stages.name: 每页内容
stages.description: 每页写成「结论标题 + 证据」：图表数据、画面描述、引用或步骤；要点页尽量少；讲稿写屏幕上没有的话。 / Each slide is a claim title plus evidence (chart data, a visual, a quote or steps); few bullet slides; notes carry what the slide does not say.

stages.name: 排版
stages.description: 排成网页幻灯片：图表画成条形图，画面描述留成占位框，讲稿单独成文件。方向键翻页，打印成 PDF 时一页一张。 / Lay out an HTML deck: charts become bar charts, visuals become placeholder boxes, notes go in their own file. Arrow keys turn pages; printing gives one slide per PDF page.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 页数、标题是不是一句结论且不超过两行、每页字数、要点页占比、证据和讲稿是否齐全、最后一页有没有明确的下一步。 / Slide count, claim titles within two lines, words per slide, share of bullet slides, missing evidence or notes, and a clear call to action at the end.
